result.summary: The application interface displays a significant visual rendering issue where an image (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) has failed to load, resulting in a placeholder state with a loading spinner permanently stuck or displayed in an incomplete manner.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar image fails to load, leaving a loading spinner (refresh indicator) visible over the banner instead of the intended promotional image.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image source URL or implement a fallback image to ensure the UI remains visually consistent if the primary asset fails to load.
